ui.heroDesc: We value your privacy. This policy explains how {{company}} collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
ui.ctaText: Still have questions about your privacy?

paragraphs.content: Welcome to AuthenticGuards, a service operated by PT. Autentikasi Garda Teknologi ("we", "us", or "the company"). We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal information.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use our product authentication services, including but not limited to:

items: The AuthenticGuards website and mobile application
Product verification services via QR code and scratch PIN

paragraphs.content: By using our services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. This policy applies to all of our operational regions in Asia Pacific.

callout.title: Important Note
callout.content: This policy is an integral part of our <Link to="/term-condition">Terms & Conditions</Link>. If there is any conflict between the two documents, this Privacy Policy will prevail for matters relating to privacy and personal data.

informasiYangDikumpulkan.title: Information We Collect
informasiYangDikumpulkan.intro: We collect various types of information to provide and improve our services. This information is categorized as follows:

items.title: Identity Data
items.desc: Full name, username, email address, phone number, date of birth

items.title: Address Data
items.desc: Home/office address for delivery and verification

items.title: Company Data
items.desc: Company name, position, and business information for B2B clients

items.title: Authentication Data
items.desc: Password (encrypted), verification PIN, and account security data

items.title: Device Data
items.desc: Device type, operating system, browser, and unique identifiers

items.title: Location Data (GPS)
items.desc: Geographic coordinates during product verification (with permission)

items.title: Log Data
items.desc: IP address, access time, pages visited, and activity

items.title: Cookies
items.desc: Cookie data and similar tracking technologies (see Cookies section)

items.title: Product Code
items.desc: Unique product code verified (QR code, scratch PIN)

items.title: Verification Time
items.desc: Timestamp of when the product was verified

items.title: Verification Location
items.desc: Geographic location where verification took place

callout.title: Data We Do NOT Collect
callout.content: We do not collect sensitive information such as credit card data, health information, biometric data, or other information specifically regulated by data protection laws.

penggunaanInformasi.title: How We Use Information
penggunaanInformasi.intro: We use the collected information for the following purposes:

purposes.title: Product Verification
purposes.desc: Verify product authenticity and prevent counterfeiting

purposes.title: Account Management
purposes.desc: Create, manage, and secure user accounts

purposes.title: Communication
purposes.desc: Send notifications, updates, and respond to inquiries

purposes.title: Data Analytics
purposes.desc: Analyze verification patterns to improve services

purposes.title: Security
purposes.desc: Detect and prevent fraudulent or abusive activity

purposes.title: Legal Compliance
purposes.desc: Fulfill applicable regulatory and legal obligations

callout.title: Our Commitment
callout.content: We will not use your personal information for purposes unrelated to our services without your explicit consent.

berbagiInformasi.title: Sharing Information with Third Parties
berbagiInformasi.intro: We only share your personal information in the following limited situations:

scenarios.title: Brand Partners
scenarios.desc: Product claim information (name, email) is shared with the brand that owns the product you claim, for warranty activation and after-sales support.

scenarios.title: Service Providers
scenarios.desc: Third parties that assist our operations (cloud hosting, payment gateway, email service) under strict confidentiality agreements.

scenarios.title: Legal Obligations
scenarios.desc: If required by law, regulation, or a valid court order.

scenarios.title: Rights Protection
scenarios.desc: To protect the rights, property, or security of AuthenticGuards, our users, or the public.

callout.title: Important to Know
callout.content: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

keamananData.title: Data Security
keamananData.intro: Your data security is our top priority. We implement layered security measures to protect your personal information:
additionalMeasures: Passwords hashed with the bcrypt algorithm
Periodic penetration testing by third parties
Routine security training for the entire team

callout.title: Shared Responsibility
callout.content: Although we implement best security measures, no system is 100% secure. We encourage you to:
list: Use a strong and unique password

retensiData.title: Data Retention
retensiData.intro: We store your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes of collection, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.
retensiData.closing: After the retention period ends, data will be permanently deleted or anonymized so it can no longer be linked back to you.

hakAnda.title: Your Rights
hakAnda.intro: In accordance with Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) No. 27 of 2022 and related regulations, you have the following rights:

rights.title: Right of Access
rights.desc: Obtain a copy of the personal data we hold about you

rights.title: Right to Rectification
rights.desc: Update or correct inaccurate or incomplete data

rights.title: Right to Portability
rights.desc: Receive your data in a machine-readable format

rights.title: Right to Erasure
rights.desc: Request deletion of your personal data (right to be forgotten)

rights.title: Right to Restriction
rights.desc: Request restriction of data processing in certain situations

rights.title: Right to Object
rights.desc: Object to data processing for certain purposes (e.g. marketing)

rights.title: Right to Withdraw Consent
rights.desc: Withdraw consent given at any time

rights.title: Right to Lodge a Complaint
rights.desc: Lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority

callout.title: How to Exercise Your Rights
callout.content: To exercise the above rights, please contact us via:
callout.responseTime: We will respond to your request within a maximum of 30 business days.

cookies.title: Cookies & Similar Technologies
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyze service usage, and provide certain features.

types.desc: Required for basic website functions (login, security, session). Cannot be disabled.
Remember your preferences (language, region) for a personalized experience.
Help us understand how visitors interact with our website.
Monitor website performance and identify areas for improvement.

cookies.closing: You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings or via the cookie settings panel on our website. However, disabling essential cookies may affect website functionality.

paragraphs.content: Our services are intended for users aged 17 and above or the age of majority under the applicable law in each jurisdiction.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under that age. If you know or suspect that a minor has provided personal information to us, please contact us immediately using the contact information below.
If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a minor without verified parental consent, we will take steps to delete that information as soon as possible.

callout.title: Parental Responsibility
callout.content: Parents or guardians are advised to supervise their children's online activity and help enforce this policy by preventing minors from using our services without permission.

paragraphs.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons.
When we make material changes, we will:

items: Update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page
Notify you via email or in-app notification
Provide a summary of significant changes
Request renewed consent if required by law

paragraphs.content: We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.

kontakKami.title: Contact Us
kontakKami.intro: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please do not hesitate to contact us via:
kontakKami.closing: For privacy rights requests (access, rectification, data deletion), please use the email subject "Privacy Rights Request" so it can be processed quickly by our team.
